dialogues.speaker: Performance Bulletin
dialogues.text: Intro: The La Verite Prize, organized by The Steambird and the most prestigious and famous media award in all of Teyvat, is used to recognize and commemorate the greatest individual and collective achievements in media, including newspapers, magazines, journals, and other media fields.

dialogues.speaker: Performance Bulletin
dialogues.text: At Lady Furina's insistence, Lady Furina has been specially invited as a guest of honor, and will personally award the prizes to the winners. Don't miss it!
